reservation_rules: Read latest main and today's ledger before any query; existing attempts count, including failed requests.
Shared limits: three sequential technique queries and one separate news query. Every query gets a unique run_id and slot.
Persist reservation with expected current head; independently read back before issuing query. On conflict reread and reconcile; never overwrite concurrent reservations.
Record exact query, UTC and local time, scope, status and result; failure counts as attempted. Batch queries each consume a slot.
If GitHub cannot persist/read reservation, stop queries. Do not depend on cloud availability, create shadow credit balance, retry historical searches or claim unsaved reservations.
Keep approved methods separate from pending-review. Existing publication, human approval and credit rules continue unless expressly superseded by this recovery instruction.
